hebrewText: וְ/הִקִּיפוּ֩ הַ/לְוִיִּ֨ם אֶת הַ/מֶּ֜לֶךְ סָבִ֗יב אִ֚ישׁ וְ/כֵלָ֣י/ו בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וְ/הַ/בָּ֥א אֶל הַ/בַּ֖יִת יוּמָ֑ת וִֽ/הְי֥וּ אֶת הַ/מֶּ֖לֶךְ בְּ/בֹא֥/וֹ וּ/בְ/צֵאתֽ/וֹ

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).

tokens.bdb: something prepared, i.e. any apparatus (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon)
tokens.kjv: armour(-bearer), artillery, bag, carriage, [phrase] furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, [idiom] one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, [phrase] psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, [phrase] whatsoever.
